scope.description: Named deep-dossier refresh for published Shift Coastal Technologies, examining current company capabilities, Canadian Coast Guard operational collaboration, Department of National Defence procurement, independent reporting and LinkedIn discovery provenance.

source.title: Shift Coastal autonomous systems integrator
source.locator: Design, build, integrate, deploy, sustain, partner network and contact sections
source.summary: Shift's current official site describes an end-to-end autonomous maritime systems integration model covering platform preparation, onboard compute, payloads, communications, command interfaces, deployment, training and lifecycle support.

leads.evidenceLocator: Current official capability statement, DND Innovative Solutions Canada Testing Stream award, Canadian Coast Guard collaboration account, and corroborating acoustic-monitoring coverage.
followUpQuestions: Can a public DND or RCN source be recovered to corroborate Shift's LinkedIn statement about work with the Royal Canadian Navy Advanced Naval Capabilities Unit?
Should future CanadaBuys amendments or DND test results add a more specific public description of the AS-188 OceanSled Ranger contract?
reviewWarnings: A Shift LinkedIn post says OceanSled Ranger supported an RCN Advanced Naval Capabilities Unit evaluation, but no durable RCN or DND page corroborating that specific activity was located; it is discovery provenance only.
CanadaBuys confirms the current DND award's title, value, dates and program path, but does not disclose technical performance, operational results or a classified requirement.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The current official site resolved Shift's end-to-end autonomous-maritime integration scope, partner posture, public contact routes and Nanaimo location.
CanadaBuys resolved an active Innovative Solutions Canada Testing Stream research-and-development contract awarded to Shift by DND for AS-188 OceanSled Ranger.
Canadian Coast Guard documentation established the delivered autonomous surface vessel, shared design-and-test work, actual Haida Gwaii use, and publicly described operating outcomes.
Independent reporting corroborated the 2026 OceanSled Explorer acoustic-monitoring field trial and identified Shift's integration role alongside Sensor Technology and Reach Systems.

leads.refreshSummary: Refresh the published Shift record with current official system-integration detail and add separately reviewable DND Innovative Solutions Canada and Canadian Coast Guard operational-collaboration programs. Preserve stable organization and capability identifiers while making the record's current procurement and deployment evidence visible to reviewers.
intendedChanges: Update the existing autonomous-maritime integration capability with current OceanSled-family, platform, payload, command, deployment and sustainment detail.
Add the active DND Innovative Solutions Canada Testing Stream AS-188 OceanSled Ranger research-and-development contract as a program participation.
Add the Canadian Coast Guard autonomous-surface-vessel collaboration and Haida Gwaii operational deployment as a program participation.
Append current public activity and evidence-boundary context to the published organization profile data.
